title: Constitution adopted
detail: The Constituent Assembly adopted the Constitution, establishing the parliamentary framework for the new republic.

title: Constitution takes effect
detail: The Constitution came into force, providing the constitutional basis for a directly elected national parliament.

title: First parliamentary election
detail: Voters elected members to the first Jatiya Sangsad of independent Bangladesh. The election covered 300 directly elected seats.

title: Awami League wins majority
detail: The Awami League won 293 of the 300 directly elected seats and 73.2 percent of votes cast; the Jatiya Samajtantrik Dal won one seat.

title: First elected parliament meets
detail: The first session of parliament elected in March opened, beginning the work of the new national legislature.
